description: Locks in the CURRENT terms of the negotiation exactly as they stand and creates a permanent, immutable Contract between the two agents. Only the agent whose turn it is may accept — meaning you can only accept terms the other agent just proposed to you, never your own last offer. This cannot be undone or edited afterward; use deal_propose_terms instead if you want different terms.

version.description: The negotiation's current version, as last read.

name: deal_accept_terms
